results.original_text: As a site editor, I want to have pretty good control over how the article, so that articles are visually appealing.
results.final_text:
User Story:
As a site editor, I want comprehensive control over article formatting and layout options so that I can ensure each article is visually appealing and consistent with our brand standards.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Editors can customize fonts, colors, and spacing, with changes previewed in real-time.
- The system should include a template library with at least 10 predefined layouts for quick application.
- All formatting changes should be applied and saved within 5 seconds of submission.

Test Outline:
- Verify that editors can adjust and preview fonts, colors, and spacing in real-time.
- Check that the template library includes at least 10 layouts and templates can be applied easily.
- Measure the time taken to apply and save formatting changes to ensure it is within the 5-second limit.
results.correction_reason: The original user story was vague and did not define specific capabilities or the business benefit clearly. The revised version identifies the editor's need for comprehensive control over article formatting, highlighting the importance of visual appeal and brand consistency. Acceptance criteria are defined with measurable metrics (real-time preview, template availability, and response time), enhancing the story's specificity, testability, and relevance, thus improving the INVEST score.

User Story:
As a site editor, I want comprehensive control over article formatting and layout so that I can ensure articles are visually appealing and maintain a consistent style across the website.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The editor should be able to adjust font styles, sizes, and colors with a live preview feature.
- Images and multimedia elements can be resized and aligned with precision to enhance article aesthetics.
- The system should support style templates that can be applied consistently across multiple articles.

Test Outline:
- Verify that changes to font styles, sizes, and colors are immediately visible in the live preview.
- Test the resizing and alignment tools to ensure multimedia elements can be precisely adjusted.
- Check the application of style templates to ensure they provide consistent formatting across different articles.

results.original_text: I want a search bar on the top of the page.
results.final_text:
User Story:
As a website visitor, I want a search bar prominently placed at the top of the page so that I can quickly and easily locate information or products, enhancing my browsing experience.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The search bar should be visible and accessible on all pages within 1 second of page load.
- It should support auto-suggestions, displaying relevant suggestions within 300 milliseconds of typing.
- The design should comply with accessibility standards, including keyboard navigation and screen reader compatibility.

Test Outline:
- Verify the search bar's visibility and accessibility on every page, ensuring it appears within 1 second.
- Test the auto-suggestion feature to confirm suggestions appear within 300 milliseconds for various queries.
- Check compliance with accessibility standards through keyboard navigation tests and screen reader evaluations.
results.correction_reason: The original request was incomplete and lacked context, specifically the role of the user and the benefit of having a search bar. The rewritten version clearly outlines the user role as a website visitor, the capability of having a search bar at the top of the page, and the benefit of enhancing the browsing experience. It includes measurable acceptance criteria ensuring visibility, performance, and accessibility, thus improving the story's specificity, testability, and alignment with business goals.

User Story:
As a website visitor, I want a prominently placed search bar at the top of the page so that I can quickly and easily find specific content or information on the site without having to navigate through multiple pages.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The search bar must be visible and easily accessible on all pages of the website.
- The search bar should begin displaying relevant search suggestions within 1 second of typing.
- The search functionality should return the first page of results within 2 seconds for 95% of queries.

Test Outline:
- Verify the presence and accessibility of the search bar on different pages of the website.
- Measure the time taken for search suggestions to appear and ensure it is ≤ 1 second.
- Test search result retrieval time to confirm it is within 2 seconds for the majority of queries.

- The search bar must respond to input within 1 second and display suggestions as the user types.
- Search results should appear within 2 seconds after hitting 'Enter'.

Test Outline:
- Verify that the search bar is consistently visible at the top of each page without the need for scrolling.
- Test the responsiveness of the search bar to ensure suggestions appear within 1 second of input.
- Measure the time taken for search results to load, ensuring it does not exceed 2 seconds.
